newsitem.title: INDIA: Air India to start Chicago flight.
newsitem.headline: Air India to start Chicago flight.

text.p: Air India is to start a new route to Chicaqo via Heathrow from May 30 and restore two fliqhts to Toronto.

But for the moment it will not resume other fliqhts to Perth, Sydney, Johannesburg suspended when aircraft were diverted to Haj charters in April, an airline official said. They were offering cargo to Johannesburg via their Nairobi route, they added.

Indian Airlines, the mainly domestic carrier, declined to disclose cargo figures for its recently added Calcutta and Bangalore to Singapore route. But an IA official said it was building up well with export of lobsters, various seafoods and two-way movement in electronics and general freight.

Bangalore will continue to offer cargo service on the A320 to Chennai (Madras) for consolidation on A300 flights to Singapore. IA Calcutta cargo officials said it is shipping 10 tonnes or more of lobster a day to the Far East where Air India also serves KL, Bangkok and Yangon, but there was stiff competition from Singapore Airlines out of India.
